skill.name: browser-task-and-automation-and-delegation
skill.description: Delegates browser navigation, form interaction, screenshots, performance checks, automated testing, data extraction, and network simulation to a Chrome DevTools expert agent.
skill.summary: Delegate browser automation tasks to a Chrome DevTools expert agent and keep the main chat concise.

content.value_statement: Browser tasks can flood the main chat with screenshots, page snapshots, and network details. This skill delegates those actions to a Chrome DevTools expert agent and returns concise results.
actual_capabilities: Delegates browser work to the chrome-devtools-expert agent through the Task tool.
Supports page navigation, browser tab management, and basic web browsing actions.
Handles clicks, hover actions, drag actions, form filling, and form submission.
Requests full-page screenshots, element screenshots, and page text snapshots.
Coordinates performance tracing, console checks, automated flow tests, and network simulation.
Extracts visible page information and monitors network requests during browser sessions.
limitations: Requires a configured chrome-devtools-expert agent and Chrome DevTools MCP access.
Does not run browser actions directly inside the main assistant context.
Needs clear target URLs, expected actions, and success criteria from the user.
Does not decide whether scraping or automated interaction is permitted on a site.

use_cases.title: Run Web Flow Checks
use_cases.description: Delegate a login, checkout, or settings workflow and receive a concise pass or fail summary.

use_cases.title: Inspect Page Performance
use_cases.description: Ask the agent to trace a page load, collect core web metrics, and summarize performance issues.

use_cases.title: Collect Page Evidence
use_cases.description: Capture screenshots, page text, and relevant network observations for a specific web page.

prompt_templates.title: Open and Capture a Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the target page, wait until it loads, capture a full-page screenshot, and summarize the visible content.

prompt_templates.title: Fill and Submit a Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the current page, fill the named form fields with the provided values, submit it, and report the result.

prompt_templates.title: Test a User Journey
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the site, complete the specified user journey, verify the expected page state, and list any errors found.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Performance Under Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Simulate the requested network and device conditions, trace the page load, and summarize metrics, bottlenecks, and screenshots.

output_examples.input: Open a product page and capture a screenshot after it loads.
output_examples.output: The page loaded successfully. A full-page screenshot was captured, and the main product title, price, and action button were visible.

output_examples.input: Test whether adding the first listed item to the cart updates the cart count.
output_examples.output: The item was added to the cart. The cart count increased from zero to one, and no console errors appeared.

output_examples.input: Analyze the homepage on a slow mobile connection.
output_examples.output: The trace showed a slow first render and large image transfers. Recommended fixes include image compression and fewer blocking resources.

best_practices: Provide the exact URL, task goal, and expected success condition before delegation.
Use test accounts and non-sensitive data when asking the agent to complete forms.
Ask for concise summaries unless you need screenshots, traces, or network details.
anti_patterns: Do not delegate actions that violate a site policy or bypass access controls.
Do not send real passwords, tokens, or payment data through automation prompts.
Do not request broad scraping when a narrow page extraction is enough.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It delegates browser navigation, page interaction, screenshots, web testing, performance checks, and simple extraction tasks.

faq.question: Does it require Chrome DevTools MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill expects a chrome-devtools-expert agent that can use Chrome DevTools MCP tools.

faq.question: Can it fill login forms?
faq.answer: It can delegate form filling, but users should provide only test credentials or approved account details.

faq.question: Can it scrape websites?
faq.answer: It can extract page information, but users remain responsible for site terms, consent, and legal limits.

faq.question: How does it reduce context noise?
faq.answer: Browser snapshots, screenshots, and network details stay in the delegated agent context until a concise result is returned.

faq.question: Is it useful for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
